title: Non-kinship quote expansion curation
rationale: Depth 0-5 stages are A/B+/B under the same runtime wrapper-quality rule used by public wrapping.
Depth 6-9 stages are uniformly C and weirdness 5.
The goal is to diversify growth semantics, not merely replace kinship repetition with deeper reporting-stack repetition.
Held C stages remain useful as research evidence and are not deleted.
v0.87.1 rotates first wrappers across the four new families and keeps them outside the legacy quote-* first-wrapper-diversity metric.
next_step: Generate reaction long-tails from the same four non-kinship source stages, then combine accepted quote stages and reactions before public integration.
